e.title: rag-assurance：法语保险条款的逐段溯源问答——语料里没有就明说没有
e.title_en: rag-assurance: passage-level sourced question answering over French insurance policy conditions, admitting when the corpus does not contain the answer
e.summary: 面向法语保险合同「一般条款」的检索增强问答系统：每句回答都给出所依据的原文段落，当语料中没有答案时明确弃答，并在 40 条人工标注问题上度量质量；作者自述场景是理赔人员原本要在 300 页条款里找一条规则
e.summary_en: A retrieval-augmented question-answering system over French insurance policy general conditions: every answer cites the exact passage it rests on, the system explicitly abstains when the corpus does not contain the answer, and quality is measured on 40 annotated questions; the stated scenario is a claims handler hunting one rule across 300 pages of conditions
e.summary_hk: 面向法語保險合同「一般條款」的檢索增強問答系統：每句回答都給出所依據的原文段落，當語料中沒有答案時明確棄答，並在 40 條人工標註問題上度量質量；作者自述場景是理賠人員原本要在 300 頁條款裡找一條規則
e.body:
**rag-assurance** 是一个**面向法语保险合同「一般条款（conditions générales）」的检索增强问答系统**（仓库 `HvalaG-tech/rag-assurance`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 5,589 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其自述线上演示实测为 `rag-assurance-hvalag-tech.streamlit.app`**；**其 topics 逐字实测为 anthropic、bm25、chromadb、french、insurance、llm、python、rag、retrieval-augmented-generation、streamlit**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把不可信之处写在明面上」**——**它的做法是：语料里没有答案时，明说没有**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：**仓库描述逐字为法语**：**「RAG sur conditions générales d\u2019assurance : réponse sourcée passage par passage, abstention explicite quand le corpus ne répond pas, qualité mesurée sur 40 questions annotées.」**——**即「面向保险合同一般条款的 RAG：**逐段给出有出处的回答**、**当语料无法回答时明确弃答**、**质量在 40 条标注问题上度量**」**。**README 逐字（8,415 字节，法语）**：**标题为「Ask your insurance data」**；⭐⭐ **开篇逐字**：**「Vos gestionnaires passent vingt minutes à chercher une règle dans trois cents pages de conditions générales. Ce système répond en dix secondes — avec le passage exact qui fonde la réponse, et un aveu clair quand le corpus ne la contient pas.」**——**「你们的理赔管理员花二十分钟在三百页一般条款里找一条规则。本系统十秒作答——**并给出支撑该答案的确切段落**，**而当语料中并不包含答案时，它会坦率承认**。」**；**并逐字给出线上演示入口与说明「Six questions guidées, sans clé ni inscription（六个引导问题、无需密钥、无需注册）」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「abstention（弃答）」是第 319–321 轮反复出现的同一条纪律在**保险条款问答**上的又一次落地**——**第 319 轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 把「what it does not prove」写进技能定义，第 320 轮 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 把「线上跑的是哪一代」说清，本条则是在**问答系统里**：**语料里没有就明说没有，而不是生成一个看似合理却无出处的答案****；**对保险业务这是要害——**条款问答的错误答案会直接导致赔付错误或合规风险，而「我不知道」是可接受的、「编一个」不是****（**可与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、[[insurance-conformal]] 的不确定性量化并读——**三者都在给模型设「不该回答就不回答」的出口****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「逐段溯源（passage par passage）」是本条目的另一个硬要求**——**它不只标一个文档，而是给出**支撑该答案的确切段落****；**这与本词条所在站点的做法完全同源：**每个结论都要能指回它的来源****；**对做条款/合同分析的学生，这提示一个可检验的验收标准：**答案能不能被人工顺着引用段落复核一遍****（**⚠️ 本次未访问其线上演示，故不转述其实际引用粒度与命中率**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「质量在 40 条标注问题上度量」值得单独记一笔**——**40 条不大，但它是**一个明确的、事先划定的评测集****；**在保险 RAG 这类项目里，**没有评测集就没有任何可比较的质量主张****；**可与池内 [[insqabench]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[insuranceqa-original]] 并读——**那两个是通用保险问答基准，而本条是**在法语条款这一具体语料上自建的小评测集****（**⚠️ 本次未读其 40 条问题的构成与评分方式**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「三百页一般条款」这一数字把问题规模讲得很具体**——**法国保险合同的「conditions générales」普遍很长，理赔人员查条款是真实痛点**；**可与池内 [[clausegraph]]（韩国标准条款知识图谱与给付审查辅助）、[[clauseguard]]、[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[evidence-review-claims]] 并读**——**那几条都在「把条款变成可用结构」这一层，而本条补的是**逐段溯源 + 弃答**这两个质量约束****。**⑤ ⭐ 技术栈实测包含 bm25 与 chromadb**——**即**词法检索（BM25）与向量检索并用**，**而非纯向量**；**对做 RAG 的学生这是一个值得注意的工程选择**（**BM25 在条款这类含大量专有名词与数字的文本上常比纯向量更稳**；**⚠️ 本次未读其实现，故不转述混合检索的具体权重与调参**）。**⑥ ⭐ 使用 Anthropic 模型（topics 含 anthropic）并给出**无需密钥即可试的线上演示****——**降低了读者的验证成本**（**⚠️ 本次未访问该演示，故不主张其当前可用**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics 十项、仓库描述（法语逐字）与 README 开头部分（8,415 字节中的标题与开篇两段，含线上演示入口与「六个引导问题、无需密钥」说明）**，⭐⭐ **但**未访问其 Streamlit 线上演示、未克隆仓库、未运行系统、未查看其语料来源、未打开其 40 条评测问题、未读 README 其余部分****，因此**不能转述其检索架构细节、引用粒度、弃答的判定机制、40 条问题的构成、任何准确率/召回率数值、或所用法语条款的具体来源与授权状况**；**② ⭐⭐ 「abstention（弃答）」「逐段溯源」「质量在 40 条标注问题上度量」三项均为**其自述**——**本次未独立检验其弃答是否可靠、引用是否精确、40 条上的表现如何**；**本词条**不主张**其已解决幻觉问题**；**③ ⭐ 「三百页一般条款」「二十分钟」「十秒」为**其自述的场景数字**，**未核实其来源或测量方式**；**④ ⭐ 其语料为法语保险合同一般条款，**该语料的来源、是否公开、是否获授权使用本次均未核实****——**条款文本通常受版权保护，本词条据此**不主张**其语料可复用或分发**；**⑤ 保险条款问答涉及**法律与合规性质疑**——**本词条**不主张**该系统可作为法律或合规意见，也不主张其答案可据以作出赔付决定**；**⑥ 该仓库创建与推送同为 2026-09-07、★0、fork 0**，**说明其极新且关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度或已被采用**；**⑦ 演示需要第三方 API（Anthropic）这一意义上的成本与隐私影响本次未评估**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 与描述实测为法语**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/HvalaG-tech/rag-assurance` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（仓库描述与 README 标题、开篇段落逐字核对）；**未访问线上演示、未克隆、未运行、未打开语料与评测集**。
e.body_en:
**rag-assurance** is **a retrieval-augmented question-answering system over the general conditions of French insurance policies** (repository `HvalaG-tech/rag-assurance`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 5,589 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its stated live demo measurably reads `rag-assurance-hvalag-tech.streamlit.app`**; **its topics measurably read anthropic, bm25, chromadb, french, insurance, llm, python, rag, retrieval-augmented-generation and streamlit**. It belongs to this round’s theme of writing the untrustworthy parts on the face of the work — **its method is to say plainly that the corpus does not contain the answer**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): **the repository description reads verbatim in French**: **"RAG sur conditions générales d\u2019assurance : réponse sourcée passage par passage, abstention explicite quand le corpus ne répond pas, qualité mesurée sur 40 questions annotées."** — **RAG over insurance policy general conditions, with passage-by-passage sourced answers, explicit abstention when the corpus cannot answer, and quality measured on 40 annotated questions**. **The README (8,415 bytes, in French) reads verbatim**: the **title is "Ask your insurance data"**; ⭐⭐ **the opening reads verbatim**: **"Vos gestionnaires passent vingt minutes à chercher une règle dans trois cents pages de conditions générales. Ce système répond en dix secondes — avec le passage exact qui fonde la réponse, et un aveu clair quand le corpus ne la contient pas."** — **your claims handlers spend twenty minutes hunting one rule across three hundred pages of general conditions; this system answers in ten seconds, giving the exact passage the answer rests on, and when the corpus does not contain it, it says so plainly**; **and it gives a live demo link with the note, verbatim, "Six questions guidées, sans clé ni inscription"**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Abstention" is the same discipline recurring across rounds 319-321, landing here on insurance policy Q&A** — **round 319’s [[powmcp-skills]] wrote "what it does not prove" into the Skill definition, round 320’s [[condition-parametric-zk]] stated which contract generation was live, and this one does it inside a question-answering system: say the corpus does not contain it rather than generating a plausible answer with no source**; **for insurance this is the crux — a wrong clause answer leads directly to a wrong payout or a compliance breach, and "I do not know" is acceptable while "I made one up" is not** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]] and the uncertainty quantification of [[insurance-conformal]]: all three give a model an exit for when it should not answer**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ "Passage par passage" is the other hard requirement** — **it cites not just a document but the exact passage the answer rests on** — **exactly this site’s own practice: every conclusion must point back to its source**; **for students analysing clauses and contracts it suggests a checkable acceptance standard: can a human re-verify the answer by following the cited passage?** (**its live demo was not visited, so the actual citation granularity and hit rate are not restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ "Quality measured on 40 annotated questions" deserves separate note** — **40 is not many, but it is an explicitly defined, pre-specified evaluation set**; **in insurance RAG projects, without an evaluation set there is no comparable quality claim at all**; **readable with [[insqabench]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[insurance-qa-en]] and [[insuranceqa-original]] — those are general insurance QA benchmarks, whereas this is a small self-built evaluation set on one specific French corpus** (**the make-up of the 40 questions and the scoring were not read**). **④ ⭐⭐ "Three hundred pages of general conditions" makes the problem size concrete** — **French policy general conditions are typically long and clause lookup is a real pain point for claims staff**; **readable with [[clausegraph]] (a Korean standard-clauses knowledge graph and payment-review aid), [[clauseguard]], [[llm-claims-analysis]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] and [[evidence-review-claims]]** — **those work at the "make clauses usable" layer, while this adds the two quality constraints of passage-level sourcing and abstention**. **⑤ ⭐ The measured stack includes BM25 and ChromaDB** — **lexical search alongside vector search rather than vectors alone**, **a notable engineering choice for students building RAG** (**BM25 is often more stable than pure vectors on clause text dense with proper nouns and numbers**; **the implementation was not read, so no hybrid weighting or tuning is restated**). **⑥ ⭐ It uses an Anthropic model (topics include anthropic) and offers a demo needing no key**, **lowering the cost of verification for readers** (**the demo was not visited, so its current availability is not claimed**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata, ten topics, the repository description (verbatim French) and the opening of the README (the title and first two paragraphs of 8,415 bytes, including the demo link and the no-key note)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not visit the Streamlit demo, clone the repository, run the system, inspect its corpus sources, open its 40 evaluation questions, or read the rest of the README**, so **its retrieval architecture, citation granularity, abstention decision mechanism, the make-up of the 40 questions, any accuracy or recall figure, and the provenance and licensing of the French clauses cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐ Abstention, passage-level sourcing and measurement on 40 annotated questions are all self-reported** — **whether its abstention is reliable, its citations precise, and its performance on those 40 good were not independently tested**; **the entry does not claim it has solved hallucination**; **③ ⭐ "Three hundred pages", "twenty minutes" and "ten seconds" are its own scenario figures**, **with no verified source or measurement method**; **④ ⭐ Its corpus is French policy general conditions, and the corpus provenance, whether it is public, and whether its use is licensed were not verified** — **policy wording is typically copyright-protected, so the entry does not claim the corpus is reusable or redistributable**; **⑤ Insurance clause Q&A raises legal and compliance questions** — **the entry does not claim the system constitutes legal or compliance advice, nor that its answers can ground a claims decision**; **⑥ The repository was created and pushed on the same day, 2026-09-07, with ★0 and 0 forks**, **so it is extremely new with very low attention**, **and no maturity or adoption is claimed**; **⑦ the cost and privacy implications of relying on a third-party API (Anthropic) were not assessed**; **⑧ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README and description measurably are in French**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/HvalaG-tech/rag-assurance` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the repository description and the README title and opening paragraphs checked verbatim); **the live demo was not visited, nothing was cloned or run, and neither the corpus nor the evaluation set was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**rag-assurance** 是一個**面向法語保險合同「一般條款（conditions générales）」的檢索增強問答系統**（倉庫 `HvalaG-tech/rag-assurance`），**MIT 許可，實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 5,589 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送 2026-09-07**；**自述線上演示實測為 `rag-assurance-hvalag-tech.streamlit.app`**；**topics 逐字實測為 anthropic、bm25、chromadb、french、insurance、llm、python、rag、retrieval-augmented-generation、streamlit**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把不可信之處寫在明面上」**——**它的做法是：語料裡沒有答案時，明說沒有**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：**倉庫描述逐字為法語**：**「RAG sur conditions générales d\u2019assurance : réponse sourcée passage par passage, abstention explicite quand le corpus ne répond pas, qualité mesurée sur 40 questions annotées.」**——**即「**逐段給出有出處的回答**、**語料無法回答時明確棄答**、**質量在 40 條標註問題上度量**」**。**README 逐字（8,415 位元組，法語）**：**標題「Ask your insurance data」**；⭐⭐ **開篇逐字**：**「Vos gestionnaires passent vingt minutes à chercher une règle dans trois cents pages de conditions générales. Ce système répond en dix secondes — avec le passage exact qui fonde la réponse, et un aveu clair quand le corpus ne la contient pas.」**——**「理賠管理員花二十分鐘在三百頁一般條款裡找一條規則；本系統十秒作答，**並給出支撐答案的確切段落**，**而當語料並不包含答案時，它會坦率承認**。」**；**並給出線上演示入口與「Six questions guidées, sans clé ni inscription」說明**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「棄答（abstention）」是第 319–321 輪反覆出現的同㇐條紀律在**保險條款問答**上的又一次落地**——**第 319 輪 [[powmcp-skills]] 把「what it does not prove」寫進技能定義，第 320 輪 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 說清「線上跑的是哪一代」，本條則在**問答系統裡**：**語料裡沒有就明說沒有，而不是生成一個看似合理卻無出處的答案****；**對保險業務這是要害——**條款問答的錯誤答案會直接導致賠付錯誤或合規風險，而「我不知道」可接受、「編一個」不可****（可與 [[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[insurance-conformal]] 並讀）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「逐段溯源」是本條目另一個硬要求**——**不只標一個文檔，而是給出**支撐該答案的確切段落****；**與本站做法完全同源：**每個結論都要能指回它的來源****（**⚠️ 未訪問其線上演示，故不轉述其實際引用粒度與命中率**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「質量在 40 條標註問題上度量」值得單獨記一筆**——**40 條不大，但它是**一個明確的、事先劃定的評測集****（可與 [[insqabench]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[insuranceqa-original]] 並讀）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「三百頁一般條款」把問題規模講得很具體**（可與 [[clausegraph]]、[[clauseguard]]、[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[evidence-review-claims]] 並讀）。**⑤ ⭐ 技術棧實測含 bm25 與 chromadb**——**即**詞法檢索與向量檢索並用**，而非純向量**（**條款這類含大量專有名詞與數字的文本上，BM25 常比純向量更穩**）。**⑥ ⭐ 使用 Anthropic 模型並給出**無需密鑰即可試的線上演示****。
